note: Fix v2: v1 (jobs/sand-legging-fix.json) fixed the skin-tone-ambiguity problem but introduced a NEW bug — Almontaser caught it: the waistband and ribbing on the Sand pair now look like a different, chunkier garment than the Black pair (thicker contrast waistband band, heavier rib texture, slightly different rise). Root cause: the v1 'extra' prompt described the fabric as having 'clear ribbing/seam texture' and told Gemini to make skin/fabric contrast 'obvious' — with no reference image constraining the garment (no_ref_image:true), Gemini treated that as license to invent/resize construction details rather than just recolour the existing ones. Fix: keep no_ref_image (still needed to escape the flawed nude reference), but (a) drop all texture-invention language, (b) add an explicit instruction to preserve every construction line — waistband width, rib spacing, seams, rise — pixel-identical to the base image, changing ONLY the hue/value of the fabric. | Re-run 2 (21:55): proof came back clean (tee black) and shipped as v43. detail STILL re-rendered the top (cream this time) and moved the arms — so composite could not lock it to the base; needs another generate.
